title: Evaluate Pilot Wave Results — 3-Item Wave 1
program: 800-Series Part 2 Pilot Execution Sprint 1 (A-Z Nested Multi-Agent Chain)

evaluate_taxonomy_definition.distinction_from_analyze: Analyze = interpret patterns, decompose systems, explain relationships. Evaluate = make judgments among competing valid options with trade-offs, apply criteria-based decision frameworks, recommend courses of action under constraints.
evaluate_must_include: Stem format: recommendation question, not identification/classification

items.stem_transformation: Classification ('are best described as') → Recommendation ('which recommendation should the owner implement?')
items.ec_transformation: Concept definition → COSO-grounded judgment rationale with budget constraint analysis, trade-off assessment, criterion-based decision justification
items.distractor_transformation: Misconception corrections → Competing-recommendation critiques with feasibility, budget, and scope-of-control arguments

items.s846_readiness: HIGH — four concrete board-level options already enumerated. Add constraints (rural hospital, $200K IT budget); pivot to risk response strategy recommendation.

items.topic: Tone at the top / control environment
items.s846_readiness: HIGH — CEO quotes, promotion patterns, board concern. Pivot to board response recommendation.

evidence: Stem changed from identification to recommendation format
Choices are competing valid recommendations, not concept labels
EC includes trade-off analysis with explicit budget constraint
EC weighs alternatives against criteria (cost, feasibility, risk-reduction)
Distractor explanations critique each alternative's limitations within constraints
Candidate must exercise judgment — no single choice is obviously wrong on facts alone
